course.title: Dart — From Beginner to Professional Practice
course.description: A visual-first, end-to-end Dart language curriculum preserving all 28 modules and 297 lessons in the supplied syllabus, with protected practice solutions, staged projects, an assessment blueprint, and optional professional pathways.
course.version_scope: Documentation checked 2026-10-19. The official async documentation snapshot reflected Dart 3.13.3; lesson examples are intended for a Dart 3.13.x-era stable SDK, not a permanent pin. Before publication, install the then-current stable SDK, verify every example with dart format/analyze/test, and check package versions/targets. Records, patterns, and class modifiers require Dart language version 3.0 or later; Pub workspace glob features can require newer SDK versions.
prerequisites: Basic computer literacy; no previous programming experience required.
Comfort with files and a terminal is helpful but taught early.
Later modules require earlier concepts; async fundamentals precede isolates, and tests/docs/dependency management precede publishing.
learning_outcomes: Write readable, type-safe Dart programs using modern language features and standard libraries.
Model data with collections, records, patterns, classes, generics, and sound null safety.
Build asynchronous file, HTTP, and server-side workflows with explicit error/resource handling.
Test, debug, profile, document, package, and prepare production-quality projects.
Choose CLI, server, web, native interop, and package-specialization paths while respecting SDK and platform constraints.
course.scope_note: Covers the Dart language and ecosystem. Flutter language integration is included; a complete Flutter widget/rendering/navigation/state-management course is out of scope.

sections_reviewed: E: Core advanced topics and optional specialization tracks
F: Suggested learning path and prerequisite relationships
G: Coverage and quality check and official references

learning_roadmap.title: Learn the foundations
learning_roadmap.goal: Install the SDK, write basic programs, and reason about types, operators, and control flow.

learning_roadmap.title: Build reusable language skills
learning_roadmap.goal: Use functions, collections, null safety, patterns, classes, modifiers, and generics.

learning_roadmap.title: Work with libraries and data
learning_roadmap.goal: Organize packages, use standard libraries, and handle errors deliberately.

learning_roadmap.title: Master async and application boundaries
learning_roadmap.goal: Use futures/streams/isolates, files, JSON, networking, and server patterns.

learning_roadmap.title: Test, secure, and maintain
learning_roadmap.goal: Test boundaries, debug and measure, shape architecture, and respect trust boundaries.

learning_roadmap.title: Build and release professional artifacts
learning_roadmap.goal: Understand compilation, interop, package publishing, and team quality gates.

learning_roadmap.title: Specialize and migrate safely
learning_roadmap.goal: Select CLI/server/web/native/package pathways and troubleshoot legacy systems.

prerequisite_map.concept: JSON and HTTP before API projects
Tests, docs, dependency/version constraints before publishing

exercise_map.title: Personal Introduction
exercise_map.skills: Print formatted information using variables and string interpolation.

exercise_map.title: Basic Calculator
exercise_map.skills: Accept numbers and implement arithmetic operations with appropriate numeric types.

exercise_map.title: Temperature Converter
exercise_map.skills: Convert between Celsius and Fahrenheit; validate numeric input.

exercise_map.title: Grade Calculator
exercise_map.skills: Use conditional statements to assign grades from scores and boundary rules.

exercise_map.title: Number Guessing Logic
exercise_map.skills: Generate a number, compare guesses, and use loops and conditions.

exercise_map.title: Multiplication Table Generator
exercise_map.skills: Use loops, formatted strings, and numeric operations.

exercise_map.title: String Analyzer
exercise_map.skills: Count characters, split text into words, and apply string methods.

exercise_map.title: Shopping List
exercise_map.skills: Add, remove, search, and display items using a List.

exercise_map.title: Unique Word Counter
exercise_map.skills: Use sets and maps to count unique words and word frequencies.

exercise_map.title: Student Record Model
exercise_map.skills: Create a class with fields, constructors, methods, and formatted output.

exercise_map.title: Expense Tracker
exercise_map.skills: Create typed transaction models, calculate totals, and group transactions by category.

exercise_map.title: Contact Book
exercise_map.skills: Use maps or model collections, search, update, delete, and validate records.

exercise_map.title: Inventory Manager
exercise_map.skills: Implement item models, stock changes, equality rules, and collection operations.

exercise_map.title: JSON Importer and Exporter
exercise_map.skills: Parse JSON, validate fields, map data to Dart classes, and handle malformed input.

exercise_map.title: File Statistics Tool
exercise_map.skills: Read a text file, count lines and words, and handle filesystem errors.

exercise_map.title: Async API Client
exercise_map.skills: Request remote JSON, parse results, handle status codes, and apply timeouts.

exercise_map.title: Stream-Based Log Analyzer
exercise_map.skills: Process a sequence of records, filter events, and summarize counts asynchronously.

exercise_map.title: Generic Repository
exercise_map.skills: Design a typed repository interface and create a testable in-memory implementation.

exercise_map.title: Concurrent Data Processor
exercise_map.skills: Partition CPU-intensive work, use isolates, and compare results with a synchronous baseline.

exercise_map.title: Retryable HTTP Client
exercise_map.skills: Add timeouts, controlled retries, error propagation, and tests for failure scenarios.

exercise_map.title: Command-Line Application
exercise_map.skills: Support arguments, help text, configuration, input validation, and meaningful exit codes.

exercise_map.title: HTTP Server
exercise_map.skills: Implement request routing, status codes, JSON bodies, and integration tests.

exercise_map.title: Reusable Dart Package
exercise_map.skills: Create a public API, document examples, apply lints, and verify supported SDK constraints.

exercise_map.title: Performance Investigation
exercise_map.skills: Benchmark multiple implementations, profile them, and report evidence-based improvements.

exercise_map.title: Platform Interoperability
exercise_map.skills: Build a small browser-interop or native-FFI demonstration, with clear platform requirements.

exercise_map.title: Testing Challenge
exercise_map.skills: Test success, boundary, invalid-input, asynchronous, and exception cases without relying on external services.
